requirement_vague: Password update should reject current_password with 7 characters. Expect 422 validation error.
requirement_precise: Register a new user via POST /api/v1/users/signup with email 'test52@example.com' and password 'oldpass123'. Login to get token. Attempt to update password via PATCH /api/v1/users/me/password with current_password of exactly 7 characters ('1234567') and new_password 'newpass123'. Verify the response status is 422 (validation error).

implementation.reasoning: The password update request model enforces current_password length to be between 8 and 128 characters, so a 7-character value like '1234567' fails request validation before the handler logic runs. In FastAPI, this Pydantic validation failure results in a 422 Unprocessable Entity response on PATCH /api/v1/users/me/password.
